user_directory.description: The directory where ZNC stores user data.

modules.description: List of global modules to load.

listeners.description: List of listener configurations for incoming connections.

listeners.items.description: Configuration for a single listener port/binding.

listeners.items.bind_address.description: IP address to bind the listener to.

listeners.items.ssl.description: Whether SSL is enabled for this listener.

listeners.items.ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (e.g., ~/.znc/znc.pem).

users.items.description: Configuration for a single ZNC user.

users.items.name.description: The username for this ZNC account.

users.items.password.description: The password for the user (hashed by ZNC usually, but stored here as string).

users.items.display_name.description: The nick the user uses when connecting to IRC networks.

users.items.alt_nick.description: Alternate nick if the primary is taken.

users.items.ident.description: Ident line sent to IRC servers.

users.items.sasl_username.description: SASL username for IRC network authentication.

users.items.sasl_password.description: SASL password for IRC network authentication.

users.items.modules.description: List of modules to load for this specific user.

users.items.networks.description: List of network names this user connects to. These must match [Network Name] sections.

networks.items.description: Configuration for a single IRC network.

networks.items.name.description: The name of the IRC network.
